text: おれと　おまえの　ちょくせつ　たいけつ　だったら　おれが　かつぜ！

structure.jp: おれと　おまえの　ちょくせつ　たいけつ　だったら
structure.en: if it were a direct showdown between me and you

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.span: たいけつ　だったら
patterns.explanation: だったら after a noun means 'if it were'. たいけつ　だったら = 'if it were a showdown'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, manly talk that pushes your statement at the listener. かつぜ = 'I'd win, man!'.
